extension.summary: Watch Crunchyroll, sign in with a QR code
extension.description: Unofficial Crunchyroll client. Sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone (crunchyroll.com/activate) - no password is typed or stored in Kodi. Continue watching, watchlist, search, browse, genres, history, profiles and a choice of audio language (original or dub).
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Crunchyroll. Requires a Crunchyroll account; premium content needs a premium subscription.
